headline: Iraq Resumes Crude Oil Export Pumping Through Turkish Pipeline at 120,000 bpd
summary: Iraq recommenced crude oil flows through its northern pipeline route to Turkey at an initial rate of 120,000 bpd. The country's oil minister stated capacity will gradually scale up to 500,000 bpd.
why: Iraq is the second-largest crude oil producer in OPEC.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Restoring pipeline export capacity increases physical crude availability in Mediterranean markets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The reopening of the Iraqi export pipeline to Ceyhan added crude oil supply back into European markets.
